children: Canada's housing market stalled in August after five straight months of gains, with resales dipping 0.7% on-month to return to May levels. Royal Bank economist Rachel Battaglia notes the pullback coincided with an escalation in trade tensions, which looks to have rattled buyer confidence while encouraging more sellers to list. Battaglia says it appears to be more of a pause than an inflection point, and stabilization is expected in the back half of 2026 and into 2027 as households navigate tariff headwinds and sentiment recovers.
